integrity: The proof independently derives a sharp dual-facet envelope from all one hundred ordered signed-facet pairs, reduces the P-angle optimization to a six-vertex chord polygon, and verifies the sharp adjacent-vertex witness. The bundled exact-field checker replays those finite certificates. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact P-angle value and weighted chord envelope are proved only for the affine-regular decagonal plane. No all-regular-polygon formula or complete classification of maximizing ordered pairs is claimed. The defining preprint has a standing dimension restriction in its preliminaries; the present result uses its displayed P-angle supremum directly in dimension two, where that formula is well-defined and the source itself discusses the Euclidean plane.
title: Exact P-angle constant of the affine-regular decagonal plane
